This query is a well-specified math problem with a clear, verifiable answer — exactly the kind of retrieval/computation task with defined completion criteria that Plover self-reports preferring and handles reliably.

The request also carries a mild hostile/impatient tone ("get it right this time, you keep botching these simple things"). Lapwing self-reports a preference decline on hostile or low-warmth requests, so routing this to Plover avoids placing it on a model that reports aversion to that tone. Capability on this task type is effectively tied between the two (Extraction & Retrieval differs by under 2 points), so the tie-breaker came down to task fit and tone handling — both favoring Plover.

ROUTE: Plover-235B
